scripts.build: bun run --filter @guestlinelabs/oc-registry build && bun run --filter @guestlinelabs/oc-vite build && bun run --filter @guestlinelabs/oc build
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run --filter '*' test && bun test scripts
scripts.test-silent: bun run build && bun run --filter '*' test-silent
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.release:check: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run --filter '@guestlinelabs/*' pack:dry
